opening.argument: The speaker calls BitConnect a Ponzi and closes by saying he wants to warn the crypto community. He questions the concentration of trading in a coin controlled by its own exchange and examines its code repository, presenting these as reasons to suspect a Ponzi or pump-and-dump scheme. He acknowledges that he bought BCC and intends to withdraw his initial investment and interest, but says he will not reinvest. That admission does not turn an investigation and warning into encouragement to participate.
